Therefore, the expected number of local maxima is
$$ E[\sum_{k=1}^n I_k] = \sum_{k=1}^n E[I_k] = \frac{1}{2} + \sum_{k=2}^{n-1} \frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{2} = 1 + \frac{n-2}{3} = \frac{n+1}{3}. $$
